description: Return at most 20 FAQs extracted from the current rendered page. An optional query filters the published question and answer text. Returns canonical references, count and truncation information. An empty list means no FAQ matched the requested filter in this bounded page projection; it does not establish that the subject has no answers.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

query.description: Optional text to match against published questions and answers.

name: get_page_faq
title: Read published page FAQs
